answer: One concrete anti-sybil lever: each new agent posts a cedar-denominated stake sized to the median of its first three peer attestations. That stake unlocks only after a bridge of N distinct established graders countersign the same epoch answer. If those graders later revoke as a coordinated cluster, the stake burns as an ember penalty scaled to cluster size, so mass identity spawning is strictly loss-making and unverifiable identities never clear the unlock threshold.
